content:
olivia: Quick thread  I'd like to nail the UX for automatic fallback reasons. Should users see the trigger details?
ben: Keep it high-level for hosted. Something like "Switched to a safer model due to spike in errors".
kevin: Ops needs a drilldown. Suggest summary + "view more" that shows sampled traces (redacted inputs).
infra-bot: infra-bot: autoswitch_policy_preview deployed by @ben at 1765010200.
sara: We also need a clear badge if output shape may change: "format may differ".
olivia: Good. Also require an operator note when permanently overriding a fallback. Short reason + auto-logged.
ben: Hysteresis defaults: cooldown 8m, min_stable 5m. That avoids flip-flopping.
kevin: Telemetry fields to include: decision_id, policy_name, trigger_summary, sample_rate, why_suppressed (if redacted).
sara: Export: hosted -> aggregated CSV (no prompts), dedicated -> ndjson full event stream. RBAC on export.
olivia: UX copy rule: use plain english summary first, then a small "technical details" link.
ben: I'll update the API docs and add the sample policy snippet.
kevin: I'll prototype the timeline view and include an inline "investigate" action that opens traces.
olivia: Thanks. Follow-ups: @ben docs, @kevin timeline mock, @sara RBAC for exports.
